location.description: The geographic location where the Catalog should reside.
location.rationale: The catalog location determines where metadata is stored and affects data residency, compliance, and regulatory requirements.
location.compliant: Catalog is created in an approved region
location.non-compliant: Catalog is created in an unapproved or unrestricted region

name.description: The name of the Catalog. Format: projects/{project_id_or_number}/locations/{locationId}/catalogs/{catalogId}

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Explicitly specifying the project ensures that the catalog is created within the intended security boundary and access controls.
project.non-compliant: Project is omitted or points to an unintended project
